analyst.summary: Ipca Laboratories is recovering nicely on margins -- operating profit grew much faster than revenue in the latest quarter as costs normalized after a rough FY23 -- while continuing to pay down debt. The business is a fully-integrated pharma maker with a domestic-formulations-heavy revenue base, which is relatively defensive, though we were not able to confirm the current USFDA regulatory status of its manufacturing plants from available sources; this is a standard, first-order due-diligence item for any Indian pharma exporter that is worth the desk following up on directly rather than a confirmed concern.
